name: DNS Resolution Mapping
description: Verifies that the learner correctly mapped domain api.octostore.app to numerical IP address 140.82.121.34.
rationale: Remote Address in the DevTools General section displays 140.82.121.34:443 for api.octostore.app.

name: Redirect Chain Analysis (301 Permanent Redirect)
description: Verifies that the learner understands that Request R1 initiates the HTTP to HTTPS protocol upgrade.
rationale: HTTP 301 permanently instructs clients to upgrade cleartext traffic to the encrypted HTTPS origin.

name: Authentication Error Detection (401 Unauthorized)
description: Verifies that the learner correctly identified Request R5 as the authentication failure returning HTTP 401.
rationale: Request R5 to /v1/user/profile failed with 401 Unauthorized because no valid Bearer token was provided in Authorization headers.

name: Forbidden Permission Recognition (403 Forbidden)
description: Verifies that the learner correctly identified Request R6 as an authorization permissions failure returning HTTP 403.
rationale: Request R6 to /v1/admin/revenue recognized user identity but rejected access with 403 Forbidden due to non-admin role.

name: Gateway Timeout Latency Investigation (504 Gateway Timeout)
description: Verifies that the learner correctly identified Request R9 as the 15-second upstream timeout failure.
rationale: Request R9 to /v1/pay stalled for 15,000ms before returning 504 Gateway Timeout from an overloaded payment proxy.

name: Insecure Protocol Isolation
description: Verifies that the learner accurately spotted the single insecure HTTP endpoint among HTTPS traffic.
rationale: Request R7 to legacy-inventory.octostore is the only unencrypted HTTP request in the recorded transaction trace.

name: JSON Payload Error Key Extraction
description: Verifies that the learner accurately retrieved the nested error code from structured JSON response.
rationale: Directly testing the learner's ability to read and parse JSON objects without running JavaScript code.

name: Multi-Request Root Cause Synthesis
description: Verifies that the learner correctly deduced that the database crash (Request R8) was the root trigger of the order breakdown.
rationale: The checkout submission crashed at R8 with a database exception, causing the frontend checkout flow to stall.
